types.name: OAuth app

steps.text: Open Settings, then Developer settings, then OAuth Apps, then New OAuth App.
Fill in name, homepage URL and redirect URIs (an agent can draft the values).
Leave 'Expire user access tokens' on unless you have a reason not to.
Click Register application and copy the Client ID.
Click 'Generate a new client secret' and store it server-side only.
